title: Kifurushi kimekwisha popup — Admin AI VPS investigation final report

root_cause.summary: POST/GET subscription verify and SSE snapshot only set suppress_expiry_popup=true for admin_revoked. Natural inactive/expired/null-subscription responses omitted the flag or set it false, so the App treated inactive as natural expiry and showed "Kifurushi kimekwisha".
contributing: Null subscription rows returned active=false without suppress_expiry_popup
Three devices wrongly pending/revoked with future expires_at (false inactive) — repaired to active

before.suppress_expiry_popup: true only when admin_revoked; missing on null rows

after.authoritativeInactive: true when active===false (access authoritative; popup still suppressed)
after.app_effect: Backend never authorizes the expiry popup

pm2.osmani-tv-backend: online legacy process observed during probe (long uptime) — public health matched osmani-admin-api commit
pm2.note: Public /api/health commit matched osmani-admin-api after reload

app_ai_coordination.required_app_change: Never show Kifurushi kimekwisha when suppress_expiry_popup=true OR expiry_popup_policy=never. Prefer treating policy=never as hard disable even if older builds ignore suppress.
app_ai_coordination.backend_guarantees: All verify + SSE inactive/expired/revoked/null payloads now include suppress_expiry_popup=true and expiry_popup_policy=never

preserved: playback authorization (playbackAllowed still false when inactive)

watch.proof: Every verify + SSE snapshot for ~30 minutes returned suppress_expiry_popup=true and expiry_popup_policy=never

app_ai_status.app_confirmation_required: App AI must confirm client never shows Kifurushi kimekwisha when suppress_expiry_popup/expiry_popup_policy=never (OTA may still be required for old clients that ignore the flag)
